content.value: Follow rails and wooden supports underground to find a mineshaft. Its supply carts hold a Tome of Transmutation. Watch for Evasive cave spiders, then use the tome on a Normal weapon or piece of armor at the [[article/runic_altar|Runic Altar]].

Press J to open the Compendium.
Open the Passive Tree and choose a class. Your class is permanent and unlocks its starting node for free.
Fight mobs for combat XP. Each gained player level gives one Passive Tree point.
Spend points along connected paths, then apply the drafted route.
Discover resources and recipes, explore biomes and visit structures to level the World Tree.
Inspect equipment tooltips for rarity, prefix/suffix runes, tier, quality, enchantment slots, and attribute requirements.
Use the inventory stats panel to judge the character total rather than adding tooltip numbers by hand.

[[stat/cranks-dungeons:strength|Strength]] is immediately valuable because every point grants 2 maximum health. [[stat/cranks-dungeons:dexterity|Dexterity]] grants 2 [[stat/cranks-dungeons:evasion_rating|evasion rating]] per point. [[stat/cranks-dungeons:intelligence|Intelligence]] grants 2 maximum mana per point.
Armour is strongest against smaller physical hits; large hits penetrate its formula more effectively. Mix in life, regeneration, evasion, [[stat/cranks-dungeons:energy_shield|Energy Shield]], and resistances instead of relying on one number.
Elemental resistances can fall as low as -100% and are capped at 75%. Negative resistance makes that element deal extra damage.
Natural hunger regeneration is disabled, so plan an actual recovery source.
If an item requirement is shown in red, its granted stats are reduced by 50% while equipped or used. Tools have no attribute requirements.
